question: After the contributor narrows the ignore rule, corrects the infra guide path, and adds terminal proof, should a repository admin authorize the resulting exact head to change `.gitignore`?
rationale: Repository automation intentionally blocks security-sensitive ignore-file changes until an authorized human approves the exact reviewed head.

options.title: Approve corrected head
options.body: Authorize the final corrected head after verifying that secret variants are ignored while safe example templates remain addable.

options.title: Drop the ignore change
options.body: Keep only the `AGENTS.md` cleanup and handle environment-file protection through a separately sponsored security-sensitive change.

recommendation.title: Approve corrected head
recommendation.body: Authorize the final corrected head after verifying that secret variants are ignored while safe example templates remain addable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership signal across both affected root files and their policy surface.
